blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp has asked the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to postpone its investigative conference on the “cash delivery” allegations of former police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. The Duterte camp said the agency allegedly failed to provide them with a copy of Gracioso’s affidavit.
